LanguageData.DS_DesignatorSafeAreaExpand_Desc: Paint cells where colonists using Flee to safe area can take shelter. The global safe-area layer can overlap stockpiles, growing zones and regular allowed areas.
LanguageData.DS_DesignatorSafeAreaClear_Desc: Remove cells from the global safe-area layer.
LanguageData.DS_Message_NoSafeAreaConfigured: Cannot flee to a safe area: no safe cells have been painted.
LanguageData.DS_Message_NoReachableSafeCell: Cannot flee to a safe area: no painted safe cell is reachable.
LanguageData.DS_Alert_NoReachableSafeArea_Explanation:
At least one colonist is configured to flee to a safe area, but none of the painted safe cells can be reached from their current position.
Check doors, walls, forbidden passages and the placement of the shelter cells.
LanguageData.DS_Alert_NoSafeArea_Explanation:
At least one colonist is configured to flee to a safe area, but no safe cells have been painted on their map.
Use Architect → Zone → Expand safe area to paint one or more shelters.
LanguageData.DS_Settings_Description: Configure how colonists using the additional defensive doctrines react to danger. The default values match the behavior used before settings were added.
LanguageData.DS_Settings_RestoreGrace_Label: Restore the previous allowed area after danger clears: {0} s
LanguageData.DS_Settings_RestoreGrace_Tooltip: How long an evacuated pawn remains restricted to the safe-area layer after no active hostile threat remains on the map.
LanguageData.DS_Settings_CheckInterval_Tooltip: How often the mod checks whether evacuated pawns remain inside their safe area. Lower values react faster but perform checks more frequently.
LanguageData.DS_Settings_ShowWarningMessages_Tooltip: Show focused in-game messages when no configured safe cell can be used. Persistent alerts and diagnostic logs remain active.
LanguageData.DS_Settings_AllowVanillaFallback_Label: Allow vanilla fleeing when no safe cell is usable
LanguageData.DS_Settings_AllowVanillaFallback_Tooltip: When enabled, a pawn falls back to RimWorld's normal flee behavior if the safe-area layer is empty or unreachable. When disabled, the pawn waits for a usable safe area instead.
